elementTree: Playwright: every element with a data-testid, framed by getBoundingClientRect plus scrollX/scrollY

kinds.NavBar: <header> with the title and its trailing button
kinds.SortButton: <button> with the label and a trailing icon
kinds.DocRow: <li> with an icon, title, shared mark, detail and a trailing button
kinds.Checkbox: <input type="checkbox">, checked while its row is picked
kinds.Dialog: <dialog> shown with showModal(), over a dimmed backdrop
kinds.EmptyState: centered icon, title, detail and button

actions.call: await operations[operation](with), through the app's data layer
actions.open: open the popover or dialog, holding which row it is about
actions.copy: navigator.clipboard.writeText of the link router.push would follow
